_comment: FCM topics are emitted as Station_{naptan} and LineStatus_{mode}_{line}.
The shapes are IDENTICAL in v1 and v2, so there is no rename to migrate —
what changes is who emits them and how many. Recorded so AV2-4.2 can prove
it did not change the shapes while moving the emission.

cases.name: two lines at one station share the station topic
cases.note: Three distinct topics for two boards. Subscribing per board would re-send Station_940GZZLUKSX twice.

cases.name: a bus hub's two directions are two stops, so two station topics
cases.note: The topic follows the POLE, not the hub. Departures are fetched per pole, so this is correct and must survive the move to the v2 model.

removalRules.name: removing one of two boards at a station keeps the station topic
removalRules.note: THE invariant. Station_940GZZLUKSX must NOT be unsubscribed — the northern board still needs it. Unsubscribing it here silently stops departures on a board the user never touched.

removalRules.name: removing the last board at a station drops both its topics
removing one direction keeps the station topic for the other
removalRules.note: Neither topic is scoped to a direction, so tracking both ways of one line means removing one way unsubscribes nothing at all.
